test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Under which Article of the Constitution of India is the Village Panchayat organised?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 40**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 40**

 
 
• Article 40 is related to the Directive Principles of State Policy mentioned in Part IV of the Indian Constitution
 
• Article 40 reads 'To organize village panchayats and endow them with necessary powers and authority to enable them to function as units of self-governments'.
 
• It is based on Gandhian Ideology.
 
 
 
• **Panchayati Raj System**
 
 
• Through the** 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992**, the government fulfilled the constitutional obligation stated in** Article 40**.
 
• Three-tier ‘Panchayati Raj System’ was introduced at the Village, Block, and District levels in almost all parts of the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**

 
 
• **Part IV of the Constitution of India from Articles 36–51 contains the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**
 
• The concept of DPSP in the Indian Constitution is borrowed from the **Irish Constitution**
 
• The Directive Principles are classified on the basis of their ideological source and objectives. 
 
 
• Socialist Principles
 
• Gandhian Principles
 
• Liberal and Intellectual Principles
